summary.intent: Land several callisto fix PRs (#541, #542, #543, #545) with green CI, then address trail findings on changes #151 (PR #543, version-lock refresh rollback) and #153 (PR #545, npm v-prefixed specs).
summary.outcome: Fixed #541 by removing an empty-entry check that contradicted an existing test, then pushed it signed and updated the PR description. For #543 the finding was fixed in apply.rs and preflight.rs, and a new regression test was confirmed red without the fix. The final check script was started, and the #545 finding has not yet been addressed.

repo: Tests in callisto's init command expect `--artifact-target` to keep empty comma-split entries so the error message can name them (test `artifact_target_flag_splits_on_comma`).

Lockfile refresh in callisto-graph runs in the order Cargo, then pypi, then npm. A Cargo-then-pnpm failure therefore reproduces the rollback bug where a later failed refresh leaves earlier lockfiles changed.
`gh pr checks --required` exits immediately because no required checks are configured on the repo.
The 'Entire Gates' check is the trail approval gate and needs the user to clear it. It is the only failing check on #542 and #543.
The registry-tools test is skipped in CI, so the local check script skips it too.

code.finding: Lockfile snapshot and refresh logic that the #543 finding concerns. Temporarily disabling the snapshot line made the new test fail, confirming the fix is needed.
Added a test for a later failed refresh, using FailingProgramRunner, which fails Cargo then pnpm and checks that earlier lockfile changes are rolled back.

workflow: Judge test results by exit code rather than grepping output. Grepping hid a failing test on #541, which broke the user's standing rule.
Verify a new regression test by temporarily disabling the fix, seeing it fail, then restoring the fix.
Check CI state on all sibling PRs after discovering a verification gap, rather than assuming they are fine.
Use `gh pr checks --watch` without `--required` when the repo has no required checks configured.
Commits are GPG-signed with `git commit -S`, and the signature is checked with `git log --format=%G?`.

friction: Output-grep verification masked a failing test, so #541 failed CI after the first push.
`gh pr checks --required` returned immediately with no required checks configured, so it could not be used to watch CI.
The trail change numbers (#151, #153) did not match the PR numbers (#543, #545), so they had to be mapped.
open_items: Finish the #545 (npm v-prefixed specs) finding from change #153.
Wait for CI on #541 and #545 to finish and report the results.
The user needs to clear the Entire Gates approval on #542 and #543.
The inference re-bump question is left for the user to decide.
The changelog heading is left unchanged, as it is deliberate behaviour and a product choice.
